THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S 482 OF CR.PC PRAYING TO QUASHING ENTIRE PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE PETITIONERS IN C.C.NO.2719/2024 FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 498A, 323,
504, 506 R/W SEC. 34 OF IPC, WHICH IS PENDING ON THE FILE OF LEARNED XLVI ADDL. C.M.M., (46TH ACMM) AT BENGALURU CITY.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER
The petitioner is accused No.2, brother-in-law of the accused No.1 - husband.
He is arrayed into the web of proceedings under Section 498A of the IPC.

2. Heard Sri. Suresh N., learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, Smt. Rashmi Jadhav, learned HCGP appearing for respondent No.1, Sri. B.V. Harish Kumar, learned counsel appearing for respondent No.2 and have perused the material on record.
3.

During the pendency of the petition, the parties to the present lis, accused No.2 and the complainant, have resolved the differences between them and have filed a joint NC:
2024:KHC:20844 memo of such compromise of a compound before this court.
The joint memo reads as follows.

"JOINT MEMO The Petitioner (Accused No.2) and Respondent No.2 (Complainant before Police) submit that, the Petitioner and Respondent No.2 have mutually settled the dispute in presence of well wishers and family elders.

Hence, the Respondent No.2 is withdrawing the allegations made against the Petitioner in C.C. No.
2719/2024 for the offences punishable under Section 498(A), 323, 504, 506, r/w Sec.
34 of IPC pending on the file of the Hon'ble 46th Addl. Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru City Accordingly, the Respondent No.2 have no objection to quash the entire proceedings against the Petitioner (Accused No.2) in this case.

sentences.text: Hence, this Joint Memo appropriate orders.

4.

ORDER i. Criminal Petition is disposed.
ii. Proceedings pending in C.C.No.2719/2024 before the 46th Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru City, stands quashed qua the petitioner.
